to: you: only the socket of the character

fields.name: q
fields.description: All timers of the character (`player.q`), not only the one that changed. The loop lowers `ms` one timer at a time (node/server.js:14735-14738), so the `ms` of this timer and of the timers before it in `q` is lower by this tick, and the `ms` of the timers after it is not yet.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the placeholder: `num` of the timer. It is the slot value from the `upgrade` or `compound` request with no conversion, so it can be a numeric string.

fields.name: p
fields.description: The `p` of the placeholder item in that slot (node/server.js:14741). The server changes this same object on each tick: it adds one digit to `nums`, or sets `success` or `failure`.

senders.what: The timer loop of the character, `upgrade` timer: a new digit of the roll, or the result (`success` or `failure`).
The timer loop of the character, `compound` timer: the same, at fixed times.
